entries.text: Implement global token-audit scripts and live tests ranking estimated tool payload hotspots while separating recorded model usage, with bounded evidence and fail-closed pagination.

Live API uses offset/has_more conversation pagination, seq/next_after event pagination, tool.completed terminals keyed by tool_call_id, JSON-string outputs with duplicated content envelopes, and turn.completed usage records.

Rank chars-per-four content payload estimates independently from recorded turn usage; suppress raw commands and outputs, expose event references, and mark missing tool results partial with nonzero exit.

The first audit assumed API default updated_at ordering, but live evidence showed created_at ordering; explicit sort=updated_at fixed recent sampling, and closing HTTPError responses fixed Python 3.15 ResourceWarnings.

Replaced audit-conversations.sh with venv delegation and added API, analysis, CLI, six live integration tests, requirements, and operational README under global token-audit/scripts without changing SKILL.md.

Ruff lint and format checks, integrity scan, shell syntax, and six warning-strict live integration tests passed; real ten-conversation audit completed over 2255 calls with historical usage gaps explicitly informational.
Useful ranked proxies are bash 470076, read 360459, grep 81852; read Markdown operations total 180419 across 83 calls, and SSH operations total 103893 across 312 calls.

Added local pyproject configuration and cwd-independent run check; the final absolute gate passed plain Ruff lint/format and six live tests from the external monorepo worktree, with integrity and shell syntax clean.

Delivered global token-audit scripts, deterministic run check, six passing live tests, safe ranked operation/sequence evidence, archived-inclusive pagination, separate recorded usage coverage, and detailed file/command/limitation handoff to parent conv-734c5107502ec413.
